body.purpose: Use Streamlit bundled sans typography; no external font loading.

metric.purpose: Tabular numeric figures; compact viewport size is 1.7rem.

extensions.nativeControls: Streamlit owns button, input, sidebar radio, tabs, progress, table and alert interaction states. No bespoke motion or shadow tokens.

components.name: Summary band
components.description: Shared tonal grouping for monthly metrics.
components.css: .ds-summary { background: #E0EDDF; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.3rem 1.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-label { display: block; color: #345441; } .ds-value { display: block; color: var(--ink, #183C30); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.5vw, 2.1rem); } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-summary { padding: 1rem; } .ds-value { font-size: 1.7rem; } }

narrative.overview: A quiet student workspace uses warm paper, sage navigation and forest accents to make financial records approachable. Botanical character comes from color and typography; controls remain familiar Streamlit components. Clear labels and visible amounts carry the meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Pale tonal surfaces with restrained green emphasis
Serif titles and native bundled sans text
Tabular monetary values and straight progress tracks

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Preserve forest for income and orange for expenses in comparative history. A single-series category chart stays forest.

dos: Do reuse the palette and native controls.
Do pair color with labels and numeric values.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and readable captions.
donts: Don't add ornamental shadows, entrance animation or external font loading.
Don't replace financial forms with novelty controls.
Don't depend on color alone for financial meaning.
